title: Golden Pond

services.name: Day Camp
services.desc: Join us at Camp Golden Pond for our summer Day Camp and learn about the wonders of nature. Camp will start on July 8, 2024 and run until July 11, 2024 from 9:00 AM until 4:00 PM daily. Campers are expected to provide their own transportation and bagged lunch. Early check in (8:00 AM) and late check out (5:00 PM) is available for an additional fee. Come and learn about the different biomes in the country, enjoy some time on Lake Louise, try your hand at archery, climb across the traverse wall, do some crafts and learn a thing or two. Weekend Fee - $75, $50 for each additional childIncludes all programming and activities Monday through Thursday daily. Day Camp with Early In/Out Fee - $95, $70
